pictures.name: QTB1-Garden-Dusk
pictures.prompt: The paradise garden at dusk: soft violet and gold light, the one tree dim in its clearing, broad green leaves scattered on the grass, the air very still and quiet, as if waiting for a voice. Tender and sorrowful. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
